compatibility_corrections.description: Preinstalled NumPy 2.5.2 in both independent virtual environments before retrying the documented package installation.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: The native documented setup failed identically in both environments while preparing scikit-multiflow 0.5.3 because its build requested that NumPy be installed first.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The scikit-multiflow build concretely identified NumPy as a missing build/runtime prerequisite that had to be present before installing the documented package set.

compatibility_corrections.description: Retried the scikit-multiflow installation with pip build isolation disabled in both environments so the preinstalled NumPy prerequisite was visible to its build.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: After NumPy was preinstalled, pip's isolated build environment still failed with the same instruction to install NumPy first because the isolated environment could not see the environment-level prerequisite.
compatibility_corrections.reason: Disabling pip build isolation was an environment-only packaging normalization directed by the demonstrated isolation failure and did not alter repository source or research semantics.

compatibility_corrections.description: Installed setuptools 84.0.0 in both independent virtual environments before retrying the normalized setup.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: The no-build-isolation retry failed identically in both environments with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'setuptools'.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The selected documented setup concretely demonstrated that setuptools was a missing package-build dependency.
